description: This file contains functions for compiling and optimizing subgraphs within a Torch FX GraphModule, specifically targeting regional inductor invoke subgraph nodes. It includes logic for identifying nodes to compile, performing the compilation, and replacing nodes in the graph.

classes.name: AOTCompiledArtifact
classes.description: Represents a compiled artifact produced by the inductor compiler.

methods.name: _compile_submod
methods.description: Compiles a submodule within a GraphModule using specified configuration and replaces the original subgraph nodes.

methods.name: _needs_inductor_compile
methods.description: Determines if a given FX node needs to be compiled with the inductor based on its metadata and operation type.

methods.name: _compile_invoke_subgraph_nodes_with_inductor
methods.description: Finds and compiles all invoke_subgraph nodes in the graph that require inductor compilation.

methods.name: _recursive_compile_invoke_subgraph_nodes
methods.description: Recursively traverses the graph to compile nested invoke_subgraph nodes.

methods.name: regional_inductor_invoke_subgraph
methods.description: Main entry point to compile invoke_subgraph nodes with custom compiler configurations.
